mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 60 degrees with moderate rain by Reddan Soccer Park and a Waning Gibbous moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The Wisconsin Department of Transportation is hosting public meetings about the US 18/151 Corridor Study between Dodgeville and Fitchburg. You can join an in-person meeting on November 18 at Mount Horeb High School or a virtual session on November 19 to review design concepts and provide feedback.

There is plenty to do in Verona today, including Yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House 360, and trivia at Hop Haus. Looking ahead to tomorrow, check out the Main Street Trick-Or-Treat event or live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In our weekly police report, on October 25, officers were dispatched to a vehicle that had been stationary for 20 minutes and arrested a 40-year-old man for O W I, his first offence.
Today's delicious flavor is OREO REESE'S Cheesecake. Culver's of Verona opens today at 10:00 AM and will be serving until 10:00 PM.
